summary: Appendix D uses theoretical prefill arithmetic, not end-to-end latency; reduced-depth evaluations cover multiple-choice only. Fixed hidden guidance retains one coda/head execution but adds vector work and state retention. Adaptive hidden guidance would require an additional unguided readout. No Apple Silicon speedup was measured in this research.

BoundProgram exposes a terminal logits row and optional hidden root. Inspected decode samples that terminal row. Qwen35 dense supplies no hidden root; Qwen35MoE supplies a normalized final hidden root after a loop over distinct layer kinds and distinct layer weight names, not an earlier shared-block recurrent state.

A future looped architecture can express fixed hidden guidance with existing elementwise subtract/multiply/add operations. Retain same-prefix reference and final recurrent states as graph dependencies until guidance consumes them; combine before coda/normalization/head. Metal arena reuse follows retirement and pins effective outputs. Fusion, retained bytes, cache layout and latency remain unmeasured. Reusing normalized hidden_root or caching the reference from a previous token changes the computation.

Proposal for owner consideration: bind an actual looped checkpoint or reproduce a documented frozen-window wrapper; preserve its initialization, damping, reference boundary and recurrence/cache semantics. Compare unguided and fixed hidden guidance at the same depth before testing reduced depth; tune on disjoint development payloads. Capture paired per-question gains and losses with same-prefix reference/final states, guided logits and selected tokens; measure dispatches, readbacks, retained device bytes and end-to-end latency. Include omega=0 identity and mismatched-prefix rejection controls. The adaptive probability margin comes from the same logits and must not be presented as independent confidence. This research does not implement or run that proposal.

The inspected author-affiliated artifact is the arXiv manuscript, which lists Apple affiliation. No LoopCD implementation/checkpoint link was observed in that manuscript. An official Apple research-page URL and author implementation license were not established; this is a bounded inventory, not a claim that they cannot exist elsewhere.
